domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: Model and provider suitability
canonical_definition: Model and provider selections are evidence-based for task quality, language, latency, security, privacy, resilience, cost, contract and risk.

conditions: All selected models and hosting or API providers, including fallbacks.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are task-specific model and provider requirements and selection criteria defined?
Are approved choices, routing, fallbacks and contractual constraints implemented in configuration and operation?
Do representative evaluations and provider evidence demonstrate continued suitability against alternatives?

capability_indicators: Suitability is tied to test results

conditions: Refer a material failure of model and provider suitability to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 2.1 (PDF p. 31), MEASURE 2.3 (PDF p. 34), MANAGE 3.1 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on relating methods to tasks and evaluating performance and provider risks in context. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make model and provider suitability verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: C2 evaluates model and provider suitability using evidence from intent through operation. AP-C2 independently assesses evidence of convenience- or brand-driven model selection.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a task-by-task evaluation plan with quality, cost, latency, availability, privacy and provider constraints. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates approved model routing, fallback restrictions, contract conditions and configuration ties to the selection record. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides representative comparative and regression results, including fallback performance and applicable provider constraints. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in model and provider suitability, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a task-by-task evaluation plan with quality, cost, latency, availability, privacy and provider constraints. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate approved model routing, fallback restrictions, contract conditions and configuration ties to the selection record. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide representative comparative and regression results, including fallback performance and applicable provider constraints. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how model and provider suitability works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a task-by-task evaluation plan with quality, cost, latency, availability, privacy and provider constraints. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use representative comparative and regression results, including fallback performance and applicable provider constraints to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: One model can serve several tasks when each task's evaluation and restrictions support its use.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-C2 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in model and provider suitability
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in model and provider suitability
Evidence remains insufficient for model and provider suitability in the assessed scope
